variants.name: 9x18mm
variants.info:
Load your Skorpion with 9x18mm Makarov.
Loading from a 30 round magazine, you lose a small amount of close range performance with reduced damage in range while retaining the same range profile. Higher bullet velocity and a higher firerate.

variants.name: Rubber Bullets
variants.info:
Load your Skorpion with .32 ACP Rubber Bullets.
Ammunition usually used by police in riot control. Improved damage to the body which falls off tremendously fast.

variants.name: Rat Shot
variants.info: Load your Skorpion with .32 ACP Ratshot. Make those shots count; with a small magazine size, Ratshot is very effective at close range but is extremely ineffective at longer ranges.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Plus P
variants.info:
Overpacked with powder, these rounds aim to make your bullets fly faster, penetrate surfaces better, and increase suppression.
Harder to control.

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
